items.title: Boring History for Sleep: A Medieval Castle After Dark (Hearth Fire & Night Watch, 47 Min)
items.description:
Spend one slow November night inside an English castle, a little over five hundred years ago. Cross the moat at dusk, watch the gate close, sit by the central hearth of the great hall while the fire is covered for the night, walk the wall with the watchman under the stars, and end in a quiet chamber with a curtained bed and a single candle.

No sieges and no battles, only soft narration, gentle rain and a long ambient ending so you can drift off.
